svg.aria-label: A bbq in chat. You: bbq, 8 questions: a site for my dogs. The agent: Round 1 of 2. Q1. One page, or several? Recommended: one page to start. Q2. Who is it for: family, or anyone? You: 1 as recommended. 2: family. After round 2, it writes down the plan.
